component.name: Mailo
component.summary: A fast, security-minded IMAP mail client for the KDE desktop

description.p: Mailo is an IMAP mail client focused on speed and safe message viewing. It caches headers, bodies and the folder tree in SQLite for instant, offline-capable browsing and full-text search, and renders HTML mail in a sandboxed QtWebEngine view that blocks all remote content until you opt in per message.

ul.li: Attachments are stored as compressed, deduplicated files outside the database; existing caches are migrated in place.
Cache size is reported in Settings, with an explicit action to return freed space to the filesystem.
Gmail's All Mail archive is no longer cached, removing a duplicate copy of every message.
Compose can save a draft, and drafts reopen for editing.
Keyboard shortcuts work anywhere in the window.
Faster start-up; folder and message selection are no longer lost to background refreshes.
